categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the pesticide industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of pesticide technical materials (active ingredients), intermediates, and formulations. Its product portfolio includes insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides, with key products such as difenoconazole, chlorothalonil, and bifenthrin. The company also engages in chemical intermediates production and has expanded into pesticide formulation sales through its subsidiary.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis technologies, including proprietary clean and green production processes for key products like chlorothalonil and difenoconazole. It has developed innovative synthesis routes, such as water-based high-temperature purification and microchannel chlorination technology, enhancing product quality and environmental compliance. The company also focuses on continuous process optimization, impurity control, and integrated production of intermediates and active ingredients.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major pesticide manufacturers and distributors domestically and internationally, including well-known global agrochemical companies such as UPL, ADAMA, Albaugh, and Sharda, as well as leading domestic firms like Noposion and Guangdong Zhongxun. Its products are used in agriculture for crop protection against pests, diseases, and weeds, targeting markets in the United States, European Union, India, Brazil, Israel, and Japan, among others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong and Hubei provinces and has established a presence in international markets including the US, EU, India, Brazil, Israel, Japan, and Southeast Asia. It exports a significant portion of its products globally and has subsidiaries in Singapore and other locations to support overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pesticide supply chain, producing pesticide active ingredients (technical materials), intermediates, and formulations. It controls key intermediate production, enabling vertical integration and cost advantages, and is expanding downstream into pesticide formulation sales to capture more value along the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment focused on developing differentiated, niche, high-margin pesticide products with low toxicity and environmental impact. It emphasizes green chemistry, clean production technologies, and continuous process innovation. Strategic R&D projects include new synthesis methods for key products, microchannel reaction applications, and formulation innovations. The company also strengthens its patent portfolio and collaborates with academic and research institutions to accelerate technology transfer and product registration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pesticide technical materials (active ingredients), intermediates, and formulations. The company uses a direct sales model complemented by distributor channels. Export sales constitute a significant portion of revenue, with pricing influenced by global market conditions and product registration status. The company also earns investment income from cash management activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic supplier of specialized pesticide active ingredients and intermediates, focusing on differentiated and niche products to avoid direct competition with large multinational agrochemical giants. It is recognized as a major supplier of SDHI fungicides, trichloromethyl sulfur fungicides, biphenyl hydrazide acaricides, and pyrethroid insecticides. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technologies, product quality, and established international customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 723 million, a 46.15% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 34.7 million, up 15.33%. The company has shown steady growth in production capacity and sales volume, with significant increases in R&D spending (5.37% of revenue). Total assets reached nearly RMB 2 billion, reflecting ongoing investments in production expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes differentiated, niche pesticide products with high efficacy, low toxicity, and environmental friendliness. It leverages proprietary clean production technologies and integrated intermediate production to ensure stable quality and cost advantages. Its products meet stringent international standards, including EU regulations, and the company maintains strong customer service and supply reliability. The focus on green chemistry and innovation supports its positioning as a sustainable and technologically advanced agrochemical supplier.
